verdict.rationale: Poly documents a notes-import path into Poly Mind from Notion, Evernote, Obsidian, Bear "and more" (poly-docs-22), and general file import from cloud drives and local storage (poly-docs-1), so Markdown files could plausibly come in as files. Nothing in the evidence says whether hierarchy, internal links, or attachments survive the import, and Roam is not named. missing for 10: explicit Roam support, documentation that structure, links and attachments are preserved, a step-by-step import guide, independent or hands-on corroboration of import fidelity
